/* FUNCTIONALITY */

-- List of Branch 1050 (Fairview) customers

Select distinct customerid
from dw.dimcustomeraccount dca
where  dca.banksk = '1' and dca.branchsk = '50' and dca.sourcesystemcode = 'DEP'

/* ROW-LEVEL SECURITY */

Select distinct ddc.customerid
from dw.dimcustomer ddc
left join dw.dimcustomeraccount dca
        on ddc.customersk = dca.customersk
left join dw.dimbranch ddb
        on ddb.branchsk = dca.branchsk
where ddb.branchid <> '1050'
and ddb.branchid <> '' 
and ddb.branchid is not null
and dca.banksk = '1'
and ddc.customerid not in 
        (Select distinct ddc.customerid
        from dw.dimcustomer ddc
        left join dw.dimcustomeraccount dca
                on ddc.customersk = dca.customersk
        left join dw.dimbranch ddb
                on ddb.branchsk = dca.branchsk
        where ddb.branchid = '1050')

/* MEASURES */

-- Deposit Balance
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R01717802')
ORDER BY BusinessDateSK DESC

 -- AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- MTD ADB
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R01717802')

-- YTD ADB
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00593007' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')
                        
-- Total Relationship Balance
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance
WHERE CustomerID = 'R00248275' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601'

-- Trust Fund Value
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTrustFundValue
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00133033' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- Treasury Investment Value
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00138866' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- Due for the Month
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- Loans Relationship Exposure
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')


-- Loan Credit Limit
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit
WHERE AccountSK IN (    SELECT DISTINCT AccountSK
                        FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount
                        WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601')

-- TOTAL Relationship Exposure
SELECT *
FROM DW.FactTotalRelationshipExposure
WHERE CustomerID = 'R00327988' AND BusinessDateSK = '20230601'


/* DEMOGRAPHICS */

SELECT DISTINCT BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId,
                DW.DimCustomer.RelationshipStartDate,
                BNKM.Employer.EmployerName,
                BNKM.City.CityName,
                BNKM.Location.LocationZipCode,
                BNKM.Gender.GenderName,
                BNKM.MaritalStatus.MaritalStatusName,
                CASE
                        WHEN BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber.PreferenceId = 'Y' THEN BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber.TelephoneNumber
                        ELSE NULL
                END AS PhoneNumber,
                CASE
                        WHEN BNKM.CustomerEmail.PreferenceId = 'Y' THEN BNKM.CustomerEmail.EmailAddress
                        ELSE NULL
                END AS EmailAddress,
                BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.CreditRiskId,
                BNKM.RiskRatingType.RiskRatingTypeName,
                BNKM.CustomerAction.CustomerActionTimestamp,
                BNKM.JobTitle.JobTitleName,
                CASE 
                        WHEN YEAR(BNKM.IndividualCustomer.DateOfBirth) BETWEEN 1928 AND 1945 THEN 'SILENT'
                        WHEN YEAR(BNKM.IndividualCustomer.DateOfBirth) BETWEEN 1946 AND 1964 THEN 'BOOMERS'
                        WHEN YEAR(BNKM.IndividualCustomer.DateOfBirth) BETWEEN 1965 AND 1980 THEN 'GENERATION X'
                        WHEN YEAR(BNKM.IndividualCustomer.DateOfBirth) BETWEEN 1981 AND 1996 THEN 'MILLENIALS'
                        WHEN YEAR(BNKM.IndividualCustomer.DateOfBirth) BETWEEN 1997 AND 2012 THEN 'GENERATION Z'
                        ELSE 'OTHERS'
                END AS GenerationalCohort,
                CASE 
                        WHEN BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer.RelatedCustomerId IS NULL THEN 'N'
                        ELSE 'Y'
                END AS ATMIndicator,
                CASE
                        WHEN BNKM.CustomerAccount.SourceSystemCode = 'MBK' THEN 'Y'
                        ELSE 'N'
                END AS MBKIndicator,
                CASE
                        WHEN (BNKM.CustomerAccount.SourceSystemCode = 'RIB' OR BNKM.CustomerAccount.SourceSystemCode = 'BOB') THEN 'Y'
                        ELSE 'N'
                END AS EBKIndicator,
                DW.DimMarketSegment.MarketSegmentName
FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Gender
ON BNKM.Gender.GenderId = BNKM.IndividualCustomer.GenderId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer
ON DW.DimCustomer.CustomerID = BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus
ON BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus.CustomerId = BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.MaritalStatus
ON BNKM.MaritalStatus.MaritalStatusId = BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus.MaritalStatusId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerLocation
ON BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId = BNKM.CustomerLocation.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Location
ON BNKM.CustomerLocation.LocationId = BNKM.Location.LocationId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.City
ON BNKM.Location.LocationCity = BNKM.City.CityId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber
ON BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber.CustomerId = BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerEmail
ON BNKM.CustomerEmail.CustomerId = BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating
ON BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.CustomerId = BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.RiskRatingType
ON BNKM.RiskRatingType.RiskRatingTypeId = BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.RiskRatingTypeId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerEmployment
ON BNKM.CustomerEmployment.CustomerId = BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Employer
ON BNKM.Employer.EmployerId = BNKM.CustomerEmployment.EmployerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAction
ON BNKM.CustomerAction.CustomerId = BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.JobTitle
ON BNKM.CustomerEmployment.JobTitleId = BNKM.JobTitle.JobTitleId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer
ON BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId = BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer.RelatedCustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount
ON BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId = BNKM.CustomerAccount.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance
ON BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId = DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance.CustomerID
CROSS JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment
WHERE BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId = 'R00327988'
  AND (DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance.TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated BETWEEN DW.DimMarketSegment.LowerLimit AND DW.DimMarketSegment.UpperLimit OR 
       DW.FactTotalRelationshipBalance.TotalRelationshipBalanceProrated > DW.DimMarketSegment.LowerLimit AND DW.DimMarketSegment.UpperLimit IS NULL)


SELECT DISTINCT BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId,
                BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.CreditRiskId,
                BNKM.RiskRatingType.RiskRatingTypeName,
                BNKM.CustomerAction.CustomerActionTimestamp
FROM BNKM.IndividualCustomer
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating
ON BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.CustomerId = BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.RiskRatingType
ON BNKM.RiskRatingType.RiskRatingTypeId = BNKM.CustomerOverallCreditRating.RiskRatingTypeId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAction
ON BNKM.CustomerAction.CustomerId = BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId
WHERE BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId = 'R00071848'


SELECT DISTINCT RelatedCustomerId
FROM BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer
WHERE RelatedCustomerId IN (    SELECT DISTINCT BNKM.CustomerAccount.CustomerId
                                FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount
                                LEFT JOIN BNKM.IndividualCustomer
                                ON BNKM.IndividualCustomer.CustomerId = BNKM.CustomerAccount.CustomerId

SELECT *

-- LOANS

SELECT DISTINCT gam.LIMIT_B2KID, gam.FORACID, aas.NMA_KEY_ID, aas.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE, gam.SANCT_LIM, gam.ACCT_CLS_FLG 
FROM BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN as aas -- Account authorized signatory / Co Borrower Details
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST as gam -- left joined to get Loans Credit Limit (SANCT_LIM)
ON aas.ACID = gam.ACID
WHERE aas.ACID IN (     SELECT DISTINCT aas.ACID   -- ACID should be an ACID of R00480392
                        FROM BUSC.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN as aas 
                        WHERE aas.NMA_KEY_ID = 'R00033206' )

LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_LIMITLIAB AS llt
ON crm.CORE_CUST_ID = llt.CUST_ID
WHERE crm.ORGKEY = 'R00033206'
  AND llt.STATUS_CODE IN ('NEW', 'RENEW', 'EXTND', 'EXPRD')
  AND llt.LIAB != 0

LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_CUST
ON BUSC.TRU_CUST.UNIQUE_ID = BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY
LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_BASELINK

ON BUSC.TRU_AUMUITF.BASE_NO = BUSC.TRU_BASELINK.CUST_NO

FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS
LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_CUST
ON BUSC.TRU_CUST.UNIQUE_ID = BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY
LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_BASELINK
ON BUSC.TRU_BASELINK.CIF_NO = BUSC.TRU_CUST.CUST_NO
LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_AUMNONUITF
ON BUSC.TRU_AUMNONUITF.BASE_NO = BUSC.TRU_BASELINK.CUST_NO

/*
SELECT *, 
        A.ThisOrderPrice - LAG(A.ThisOrderPrice)
        OVER(ORDER BY A.OrderID) AS DiffFromLast
*/

WITH DEP_BAL_0601_0602 AS (
        SELECT *,
                A.BalanceAmountFull - LAG(A.BalanceAmountFull)
                OVER(PARTITION BY A.AccountID ORDER BY A.BusinessDateSK) AS DiffFromLast
        FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT AccountID,
                                BusinessDateSK,
                                BalanceAmountFull,
                                BalanceAmountProrated
                FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance
                WHERE BusinessDateSK IN ('20230601', '20230602')
        ) AS A
)

SELECT DISTINCT BusinessDateSK
FROM DEP_BAL_0601_0602

FROM DEP_BAL_0601_0602
GROUP BY DiffFromLast
*/

        SELECT *,
